title: Thankfulness
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child lists why we thank others and when, with 1 Thessalonians 5:18.

floor.question: How can you thank your parents?

board.do: Wait for the child to give a reason.

misconceptions.ask: Should you say thank you when a friend lends you a pencil?
misconceptions.repair: Practise thanking for small things all day.

misconceptions.ask: Should you thank your mother for cooking?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how mother feels when thanked.

misconceptions.ask: Name another way to thank someone apart from words.
Should we thank people as well as God?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Thessalonians 5:18 and role-play thanking a friend.

checks.question: Give a reason for thanking others.
When should you say thank you?
